'''''Atractylis cancellata''''', known by the common name cage thistle, is a species of [[Annual plant|annual]] herb in the family [[Asteraceae]]. They have a self-supporting growth form and simple, broad leaves and dry fruit. Individuals can grow to {{convert|2|cm|in|abbr=on}} tall.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Atractylis cancellata L. - Encyclopedia of Life|url=https://eol.org/pages/6263953|access-date=2022-02-04|website=eol.org}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|last=Mifsud|first=Stephen|date=2002-08-23|title=Atractylis cancellata (Cage Thistle) : MaltaWildPlants.com - the online Flora of the Maltese Islands.|url=https://www.maltawildplants.com/ASTR/Atractylis_cancellata.php|access-date=2022-02-07|website=www.maltawildplants.com|language=en-us}}</ref>
